protocol.data: Train Session1 only; no cross-session claim
protocol.outer: 5-fold subject holdout; 4 subjects/fold at default, all held-out trials unknown
protocol.known_outer_test: last 20% trials within each registered subject/task
protocol.inner: 2 pseudo-unknown subject groups; registered 60–80% trials and pseudo-unknown first 80% trials select score/threshold; disjoint from outer last 20%

variants.fused: fixed task-specific full/window/low-Ridge/neighbor fusion; no batch operations

protocol.attack: feature-space L∞ FGSM/PGD against fused scores; epsilon in per-feature training SD units; not raw-EEG attack
protocol.graph_pair: oracle clean/adversarial correspondence; non-adaptive ideal-pair upper bound
protocol.sinkhorn: oracle enrolled-only clean+adversarial batch diagnostic; not a deployable open-set rule

candidate.variant_selection_source: highest mean inner detection macro-F1 across outer folds
candidate.threshold_source: 5th percentile of existing all-subject blocked-OOF known scores; no test labels
candidate.test_accuracy_claim: unknown; experimental candidate, formal answer untouched
